unit.why: The division is a transcribed letter of authorization (כתב סמיכה) from R. Avraham Yaakov of Sadigura to R. Menachem Mendel of Zablitov. It approves his making his late father's journeys among the hasidim and asks the hasidim to support him. It is a document, not a narrated sequence of events.
unit.boundary_note: The division's first word ('לגודל') repeats the catchword at the end of the previous division. The letter is self-contained, and the next division begins a new entry (hillula date).
